outcome: Childbirth fear (measured by Wijma delivery expectancy/experience questionnaire)
cohort: 80 nulligravid women who scored >=66 on the Wijma delivery expectancy/experience questionnaire, indicating fear of childbirth.
finding: The BELIEF protocol significantly reduced childbirth fear and increased childbirth self-efficacy compared to routine prenatal care.
mod_finding: More women in the intervention group reported a preference for normal vaginal birth compared to the control group.
